posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
Has anyone any comments re the suitability of these for display holography? The 50 mW version looks nice for small-scale DCG work.

Though they claim SLM operation, there is no spec on how clean the spectrum is and I wondered if any holographers out there

had tried them. I will accept private messages if confidentiality agreements (or libel laws ) require non-public discussion.

[http://www.oxxius.com/pages/en/products/slim-473.php](http://www.oxxius.com/pages/en/products/slim-473.php)

posts.author: Sergio
posts.content_md: They claim a single longitudinal mode and with the monolithic resonator I think the cavity is a small one to eliminate the adjacent modes while maintaining the maximum power at 50mW, this is the simplest way to get it, on green lasers the WL stability over my etalon tests are fairly excellent with these monolithic crystals (that does not use alignment mirrors).
